description: This file declares internal functions and defines related to ASN.1 RSADigestInfo objects used in ASN.1 encoding/decoding, specifically for RSA digest info structures in a cryptographic context.

methods.name: AnscAsn1RSADigestInfoCreateChildAttr
methods.description: Creates and returns attribute object for a child element at the given index within an RSADigestInfo ASN.1 structure.

methods.name: AnscAsn1RSADigestInfoGetChildName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the child element at the specified index within the RSADigestInfo ASN.1 structure.

methods.name: AnscAsn1RSADigestInfoCreateChildObject
methods.description: Creates and returns a handle to a child ASN.1 object based on the specified index within RSADigestInfo.
